claims.value: Granite-3B-Code-Instruct-2K is a 3B parameter model fine-tuned from Granite-3B-Code-Base-2K on permissively licensed instruction data to enhance instruction following, logical reasoning, and problem-solving. It is deprecated for new projects.
claims.evidence: is a 3B parameter model fine tuned from *Granite-3B-Code-Base-2K* on a combination of **permissively licensed** instruction data
New applications/projects should use the latest mainline Granite language model family, whose code capabilities supercede this model.
designed to respond to coding related instructions and can be used to build coding assistants.
